value.signature: fn marker_policy_declaration (input : & crate :: burn :: PolicyInput , burn : & crate :: burn :: ValidatedBurn ,) -> Result < DeclarationContent , crate :: burn :: BurnError >

review.body: { let result = crate :: burn :: validate_policy (input . clone () , burn) . map (| _ | DeclarationContent :: MarkerPolicy { recipe : MARKER_POLICY_RECIPE . into () , digest : marker_policy_digest (input) , }) ; if result . is_err () { super :: refused () ; } result }
review.item_premise: The publication producer validates public policy content against validated burn before returning its recipe and digest together; refusal preserves the typed cause and records refusal without constructing a publication.
